title: Fly with the California National Guard as they battle wildfires
description: California Army and Air National Guard aircraft and their crews from the 129th Rescue Wing, out of Moffett Field, and the 3-140th Aviation Battalion, out of Los Alamitos, stage near Redding, Calif., as they fill up their Bambi Buckets at nearby water sites and drop them on the Ponderosa Fire, Aug. 24, 2012. The citizen Soldiers and Airmen are assisting CAL FIRE and other agencies in numerous wildfires raging across the northern part of the Golden State. Air National Guard video/Master Sgt. David Loeffler.
